text: Ko an yo Annabiijo! Maakan suddiiɓe maa ɓen, e jiwɓe maa ɓen, e genndiraaɓe gomɗimɓe ɓen, yo ɓe tuggorta wutteeji (dolekkeeji maɓɓe juuti) ɗi ɓe ɓoornotoo ɗin, fii wata terɗe maɓɓe ɗen hunco yeeso worɓe njanamɓe ɓen. Ko ɗum ɓurata ɓaɗtaade, nde ɓe annditee wonnde ko ɓe rinɗuɓe, hara gooto lorrataa ɓe, wata horɓe ɓen lorrirtee. Alla siforii Haforanoowo junuubi kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
